text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the end of last year, Wonder Acute
was finally
able to race against Smart
Falcon in the Tokyo
Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can't help but wonder how much
influence her
steadfast efforts have had
on those looking for a
fresh start, so we
decide to ask around.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This boxing gym is run by Wonder
Acute's father.
We arrive to find the
students training hard with
some
roadwork.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text: Ah, look! It's Miss Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come now. You make it sound like
I'm
someone fancy when you call me
that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's so awfully embarrassing. Oh my... Is it
getting
warm out here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I frantically stop a blushing Wonder
Acute from
running off.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Um, by the way... Did any of you happen
to see
the Tokyo Daishoten?

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text: You bet! We all watched it together!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh? And, um, what did you think?

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
It was so great seeing you out there
running! I
couldn't believe you were
competing in such a
major race!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text: You're really something else!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, is that right? I'm so glad to hear
that.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Who knows? Maybe there's hope
out there
for the rest of us too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, the boxers jubilantly get
back to
their training.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, guys! As long as you keep
plugging
away and putting one foot in
front of the other...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student
text_block_list.text:
Someday, you might just get to see the
glory of a
champion with your own eyes!
So show me your
fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Students
text_block_list.text: Rah!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: See a champion... not be one? Hm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A somewhat blank expression rolls over
Wonder
Acute's face. Sometime later...

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Of course I watched you, darling. You
were
splendid. Simply splendid.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
All I could think about was how
wonderful it was
that you were able to
run in a race like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The elderly folk react in much the same
way as
the boxers. They're all overjoyed
to see Wonder
Acute advance in her
racing career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But... that seems to be all they felt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute stands there for a long
moment, as
if in deep contemplation.
Then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Can you tell me something, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When exactly did Mr. Gold... become
Ms. Silver?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what she's talking about.

Wonder Acute takes a deep breath
before
continuing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was a kid, I used to like
watching
period dramas.

text_block_list.name: Young Acute
text_block_list.text:
I am the mighty Mr. Gold! Bow before
me and
bask in my glow!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I always used to pretend I was the main
character.
I thought being the biggest
star among the
Umamusume was so
cool...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My personality had become more
subdued, like
tarnished silver. Suddenly,
I was content to sit
back and support
others with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is this what it means to grow up? Or...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that I'm just trying too hard
to be
wise... suppressing my own
instincts in the
process.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can feel a drive in her words more
powerful than
anything I've felt from her
before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer... There is a beast within me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it. Especially when my mind is
foggy
while doing a cut.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm somehow able to hold it at bay by
living my
life at a relaxed pace...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how slow I try to take
things, I can
still feel it lurking in the
depths of my soul.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even at this very moment, I want to
break into a
dash. I want to win. And
once I've become the
best, I want to
hold onto that glory forever...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There are Umamusume who never bother
to hide
those desires. They blaze
straight ahead without a
doubt in their
mind.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I admire them. And not simply because
they're
talented racers.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
People often say that even though
something
looks good on paper, it
doesn't mean it will work
in real life.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My running might look steadfast, but I
lack the
charisma needed to inspire
others to dream.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that alone is enough to lead a
long career,
but if I want to fill everyone
with the desire to get
back on their feet
and shine again...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that merely catching up to
Smart
Falcon won't cut it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just giving her a run for her money won't
move
any hearts. To move hearts, she
needs to make
others yearn to bloom
once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She needs to make them want to
become the
stars of their own story. And
to do that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I want to beat her... I want to outshine
Falco.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I want to win, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Wonder Acute's dogged
perseverance is her
greatest asset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All she has to do is keep running in the
Twinkle
Series. If she keeps building up
experience, then
someday...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know I could just let time do its magic.
I could
watch the seasons go by as I
slowly grow stronger
and stronger, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But the thing is... I want to win right now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Some people don't have much time left
in this
world. All I want is to give them
hope—no, that's
not all I want.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I... I also want to win now... for myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's more to this than simple virtue.
Her basic
instincts are driving her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's heart is set on
becoming a star.
She wants to outrun
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We don't have enough time. The gap
between her
and Smart Falcon is still too
big.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to stand a real chance, then
her
current training regimen won't be
enough...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I believe that silver will never outshine
gold. Not
with the same amount of each,
at least.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But imagine if we could gather up all the
luster
from all the silver I'd otherwise
gather over the
years... and flash it all at
once.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Imagine if we could get it all without
having to
wait around forever. Sure,
wisdom comes from
living long and
well...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But couldn't there also be wisdom in disregarding all that to charge in, full steam ahead?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind. I'm happy to live in the
fast lane
for a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand what she's trying to say.
She wants
to take all her tenacity and
endurance—her two
greatest strengths...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And toss them both in favor of an
all-or-nothing
total overhaul for the
upcoming Kawasaki Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm already mentally prepared for it.
Talking to
everyone convinced me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you're the most knowledgeable
about
running. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you think a little recklessness will get
me
where I want to be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from her eyes, she's dead
serious. And I'm
well aware of Wonder
Acute's full potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My outlook isn't clouded anymore. If I
were to
push her to the limit starting
now...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, then that's settled.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's not a problem. I'm willing to go to
any
lengths for this.
choice_data_list: でも！反動は大きいかもしれないよ！？

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen the splints used to
support
trees? I'd bet top dollar that
they're plenty happy
knowing they're
promoting that tree's growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...The tree before me shows wisdom
beyond her
years, but she is neither
wizened nor old. In fact,
she is far more
flexible—more sturdy than I could
ever
imagine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... The staircase at this shrine... sure is long... Not to mention arduous...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Ten? So this is what I have to do, huh?
Well...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to push through. That's
right, I'll
tackle anything you throw at
me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm not holding anything back.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Who knew you could improve so much if
you just
stop fretting about tomorrow?
Letting down your
hair every once in a
while is actually quite nice.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We complete one long, grueling training
session
after another—all in an attempt
to get an
advance on her future gains.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We snatch up all the time—all the silver
that she
would have normally passed
leisurely...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And polish it to the best of our ability.
Day in and
day out, we train...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until finally, it shines brilliantly, like the
work of a
master craftsman.
